description: Covers the red tests compiler2_transport_plan_keeps_enum_reduce_operator_refs_direct_callable, fixpoint_leaves_no_reached_fn_unknown_fold_capture_closure, and corpus_folds_settle_myreduce_to_int_fold_capture_closure. Likely root cause: direct reducer callable transport for operator refs and captured closure folds is not carrying the exact settled integer result/callable surface facts into transport/native, producing Ty(0) transport lanes or a LowerNativeProgram fatal. Start with the transport contract for Enum.reduce operator refs, then drive the fold_capture_closure tests through the same proven facts. Do not recover reducer ABI from native types or old callable layout machinery.
title: Artifact seam: preserve direct reducer callable integer facts
